title: Add true-raymarching text reveal section to immersive demo
abstract:
## What Adds a new **"Text load-in v2 — true raymarching"** section to `/demo/immersive`, placed directly below the previous text load-in attempt. It's an improved approach to the same reveal, built from the techniques in Maxime Heckel's [Painting with Math: A Gentle Study of Raymarching](https://blog.maximeheckel.com/posts/painting-with-math-a-gentle-study-of-raymarching/). ## Why it's an "improved approach" The previous attempt (`RayMarchedHeading`) only marches 2D blur taps along a smear line — it isn't real raymarching. The new section applies the article's actual technique end-to-end: - **Signed distance field**: the DOM heading's glyphs are rasterized at their measured positions and converted into a real SDF via an exact Euclidean distance transform (Felzenszwalb–Huttenlocher, tiny-sdf style seeding for sub-pixel edges), then extruded into 3D (`opExtrusion`). - **True raymarcher**: ray origin + per-pixel ray direction, marching by the scene SDF distance up to `MAX_STEPS` until within `SURFACE_DIST`. World units are CSS pixels so a ray through pixel *q* hits the text plane exactly at *q*, keeping GL and DOM aligned. - **`smoothmin` goo**: the reveal is a smooth-max intersection with a sweeping half-space, and metaball droplets ride the front, melting into the emerging glyphs via the article's polynomial smooth-min. - **SDF-gradient lighting**: hits are shaded with normals from the SDF gradient (Inigo Quilez's `getNormal`) — ambient from `normal.y` plus diffuse — with a Beer's-law exponential depth fade. - **Crisp handoff**: as progress settles, the shader converges onto analytically antialiased flat glyphs and crossfades to the selectable DOM heading, same pattern as the previous attempt. ## Files - `src/features/immersive/ui/raymarched-sdf-heading.tsx` — SDF build + raymarching shader overlay - `src/features/immersive/ui/text-load-in-raymarched.tsx` — eyebrow scramble → raymarched heading → body timeline (mirrors `TextLoadIn`) - `src/widgets/immersive-demo/ui/text-load-in-raymarched-playground.tsx` — leva GUI (march steps, extrusion, smooth-min k, front softness, sweep angle, droplets, wobble, light angle, timings) - `immersive-demo-page.tsx` / `features/immersive/index.ts` — new `DemoSection` below the previous attempt + export ## Verification - `tsc --noEmit` and `biome check` pass on all touched files. - Verified in headless Chromium against a local Postgres + dev server: the shader renders, the goo sweep plays, and the section settles to the crisp DOM heading. Mid-reveal (raymarched droplets melting into the extruded glyphs): [Mid-reveal frame](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-019fb0f7-869e-7b18-84b9-27ed6ed8f046/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fraymarch-reveal-mid.png) Settled (crossfaded to the crisp DOM heading): [Settled frame](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-019fb0f7-869e-7b18-84b9-27ed6ed8f046/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fraymarch-reveal-settled.png) No schema changes — no migration needed. To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
  
## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a raymarched text reveal animation with goo-like transitions, lighting, and responsive rendering. * Added viewport-triggered playback, replay controls, reduced-motion support, and customizable animation settings. * Added a new interactive playground to preview and adjust the text reveal effect. * **Accessibility** * Respects reduced-motion preferences and provides an accessible text experience.
